title: The Causative Insects in Severe Insect Sting Allergy
brief_summary: Study the causative insect by skin prick test and sIgE to wasp, bee and fire ants are important but false positive by crossreactivity can occur. sIgE to recombinant venom allergen is proposed to help in finding the causative insect.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Cases with severe insect sting allergy reactions

Exclusion Criteria:

* Without other severe systemic diseases
* Not pregnant or lactation
